summary: Rendered output of option and return value references; dots reference suboptions and contained values, and [...] array stubs indicate list elements.
questions: How do I reference a nested return value inside a list in docs?

answer_card.title: Nested option and return value references
answer_card.answer_md:
Use `.` for suboptions/contained values and `[...]` for list elements:
`:ansretval:`ansible.builtin.service_facts#module:ansible_facts.services['systemd'].state`` references `ansible_facts.services.state`.
